method: frozen P2 artifacts only — no new model runs

t4.note: Two models cannot form a majority. Consensus-correct is the ensemble's guaranteed floor; disagreement rate is the fraction needing a tiebreak, where an 8B tiebreak must beat the stronger single model to add value.

r2.note: union_closed_oracle_ceiling assumes a perfect per-case selector. A verifier-guided selector can reach it only if it can identify WHICH model is right per case — that is the whole difficulty of this track.
